items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [rust (juici) (⭐0)](https://github.com/Juici/zsh-rust-completions) - ZSH completion definitions for rust.

### Completions / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [macos (⭐0)](https://github.com/danydodson/zsh-completions) - Completions for selected OSX commands. This repository's main purpose is to create quality auto completions, e.g. conditional flag aware presentation and selection of choices, as well as up-to-date and feature-complete auto completions.
